title: A debt's one-check Retire accepts that check's own pass on the PR head
why: A debt whose Retire is one browser check can close while other browser checks are red.
note: Coordinator 23:35 CST Nov 6, from runner 9 at 23:34 CST: decision debt-close-runs-retire refused q_max #1052. #1042 closes debts RAIL and SIDE-EDGE, whose Retire is one browser check, and check_debt_retire accepts only a whole green browser.yml run. Main's browser suite is red for other checks (items 325-327), so the debts can never close. Fix: let check_debt_retire accept a per-check pass from the named check's shard job in a CI run on the PR head. It changes a guard. Meanwhile #1042 keeps both debts open.
